There are many well-known office furniture brands with official websites where you can explore products, design solutions, and purchase or request quotes. Below is a list of prominent office furniture brands and their official websites:

### **Global & North American Brands**
1. **Herman Miller** – [www.hermanmiller.com](https://www.hermanmiller.com)  
   *Known for ergonomic office chairs (e.g., Aeron Chair) and modern workspace design.*

2. **Steelcase** – [www.steelcase.com](https://www.steelcase.com)  
   *Offers a wide range of office furniture, seating, desks, and space-planning solutions.*

3. **Haworth** – [www.haworth.com](https://www.haworth.com)  
   *Specializes in office systems, seating, and workplace design for global markets.*

4. **Knoll** – [www.knoll.com](https://www.knoll.com)  
   *Offers contemporary office furniture, seating, and architectural furnishings.*

5. **Humanscale** – [www.humanscale.com](https://www.humanscale.com)  
   *Focuses on ergonomic, sustainable office designs and award-winning task chairs.*

6. **Vitra** – [www.vitra.com](https://www.vitra.com)  
   *Swiss brand known for high-design office and home office furniture.*

7. **Office Designs (by Allsteel)** – [www.allsteel.com](https://www.allsteel.com)  
   *Offers modular workspaces, storage, and collaborative furniture.*

8. **Kimball Office** – [www.kimballoffice.com](https://www.kimballoffice.com)  
   *Provides team workspaces, desks, and storage solutions.*

9. **Global Furniture Group** – [www.globalfurnituregroup.com](https://www.globalfurnituregroup.com)  
   *Offers budget-friendly and customizable office furniture.*

10. **ErgoCentric** – [www.ergocentric.com](https://www.ergocentric.com)  
   *Focuses on sit-stand desks and ergonomic office solutions.*

---

### **European & International Brands**
11. **USM Haller (USM)** – [www.usm.com](https://www.usm.com)  
   *Famous for modular, timeless metal furniture systems.*

12. **Normann Copenhagen** – [www.normann-copenhagen.com](https://www.normann-copenhagen.com)  
   *Offers stylish, modern office and home office furniture.*

13. **Fritz Hansen** – [www.fritzhansen.com](https://www.fritzhansen.com)  
   *Danish design brand with iconic seating and tables.*

14. **Vondom** – [www.vondom.com](https://www.vondom.com)  
   *Modern, design-forward office and contract furniture (primarily furniture for reception/lounges).*

---

### **Budget & Value-Oriented Brands (Online Focused)**
15. **Uplift Desk** – [www.upliftdesk.com](https://www.upliftdesk.com)  
   *Popular for customizable sit-stand desks and ergonomic office setups.*

16. **Fully (by Fully.com)** – [www.fully.com](https://www.fully.com)  
   *Sells ergonomic furniture including the Fully Jarvis desk.*

17. **Autonomous** – [www.autonomous.ai](https://www.autonomous.ai)  
   *Known for smart desks and affordable office seating.*

18. **IKEA Business** – [www.ikea.com](https://www.ikea.com) (see Business section)  
   *Offers affordable office furniture solutions for small offices and home offices.*

---

These brands serve various sectors—from corporate offices and co-working spaces to home offices—and many offer B2B services, interior design consultations, and sustainable or modular options.

Let me know if you're looking for brands in a specific country or with a focus on ergonomics, sustainability, or modern style!
